source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
In your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), pick 1 of these abilities; every **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit of yours has it until your next [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins. As each phase begins, any of those units that a **HURON BLACKHEART** model of yours can see has both abilities until that phase ends.

- **Huron’s Elite**: attacks by the unit's models get +1 to **Hit rolls**.
- **Mobile Marauders**: Falling Back does not stop the unit shooting or declaring a charge that turn.

If a unit has Mobile Marauders only because **HURON BLACKHEART** can see it, and he cannot see it after its **Fall Back move**, it loses the right to shoot during your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) and to declare a charge during your [Charge phase](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase) unless he can see it again as that phase begins.
